title: UI Design Optimize Plan 1.0.0
description: Declarative reference only. The zero-dependency runtime validator scripts/lib/schema.mjs (validateOptimizePlan) is the single source of truth and is stricter. An optimize plan is the vision model's one-shot output for the automated see -> fix -> re-see loop: it bundles a review of the current UI plus a redesign spec that fixes the issues the reviewer found.

review.description: A valid review object (mode: review). See schemas/review.schema.json.

spec.description: A valid spec object (mode: redesign, with designTokens). See schemas/spec.schema.json.
